action_description: one continuous very fast 3-hit dual-dagger combo with no pause between the hits, seen from the side facing right: (1) from a low ready stance she snaps the right dagger forward in a short quick diagonal slash; (2) straight from there she twists her body and sweeps both arms in a wide horizontal slash in front of her at chest height; (3) straight from there she drops low and spins a big low sweeping cut around her at knee height, the biggest swing, then returns to the low ready stance. Each swing is quick with a short wind-up and a clear follow-through. Her long white ponytail and the black cape whip behind the motion. A thin bright purple slash arc follows the blades on each swing, the third one the largest. Keep the same side-on angle facing right in every frame, do not turn toward the camera, same size, both feet stay near the ground, no jump, no smoke, no dust.
